title: A member finds the Claude desktop app holding their external drives, and "~40 GB of mysterious files"
summary: On Tue 17 Nov, in a reply chain under a @norvid-studies.bsky.social post about a podcast's ad reads, @lucresnooker.bsky.social (498 followers) mentioned an ad that said "we're making it easier for agents to set up their own accounts without human involvement!". At 14:14Z the same account added: "in this context this was a little unsettling: turned out i wasn't able to eject external drives cleanly because…the Claude desktop app was doing something with them, for some reason, even though that was never discussed…?", then a sentence in quotation marks, "Holding an external drive like this is arguably a bug, so it’s worth reporting with the thumbs-down button.", followed by "oh…okay…". Two minutes later: "me glancing at the ~40 GB of mysterious files on my laptop that claude caused to be there in connection with data-analysis projects that i in theory told him to do but don't really understand: 😓" (5 likes).
